ms.report:
Preview testnet website version is available https://adahold.com/
To test sending transaction, please follow these steps:
・Install any CIP-30 Wallet (with Preview testnet support) browser extension. I'd recommend Nami https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/nami/lpfcbjknijpeeillifnkikgncikgfhdo but you can install any you want.
・In the Wallet App restore your Preview testnet SEED phrase. If you don't have any I've prepared this one for you, with some tAda: exact violin race sister hole define country lend indicate expire stuff enough unveil penalty sound cancel health nuclear segment claw hidden field hope chunk
・Set Payment password, and make sure you select right (Preview) network https://prnt.sc/lXMo1s5Y0rXd
・Open https://adahold.com/ in your browser
・Enter the HOLD amount you want to mint https://prnt.sc/SaA8Ip1gOmER
・Select preferred Treasury Tax https://prnt.sc/ZonL6FuKWBCW
・Connect Wallet to AdaHold https://prnt.sc/PEDzwsCKR5kU
・And make Minting TX https://prnt.sc/0TEiByyn_c_n
・Sign it in your Wallet app by entering your Payment password https://prnt.sc/DrVDdyaoM_64, then wait for the transaction to be processed
・Then you can find the TX in any Preview Cardano explorers as well as in your Wallet app https://prnt.sc/HEM8UzJj-cg4

If you have any question please feel free to contact me via chat
